## About
Dr. Joe Gutierrez, or Dr. G as his patients call him, earned his Doctor of Chiropractic degree from Parker College Of Chiropractic in Dallas. After years of practicing in Dallas, Denton and Little Elm, he made Frisco his chiropractic home.
At Gutierrez Chiropractic, we always consider the health of our patients first. Our staff delivers care in a friendly, professional atmosphere, and we treat our patients the same way we like to be treated.
Outside the office, Dr. G enjoys watching his children at their sporting and cheering events, traveling, golfing, fishing, music and spending time with the Frisco community. He truly welcomes all and knows no stranger.

## Services
- Chiropractic care: Care from Dr. G, who earned his Doctor of Chiropractic degree from Parker College Of Chiropractic.
- Massage Therapy: A hands on approach that targets specific muscles or muscle groups in need of relaxation and stress relief.
- Electrical Stimulation: Used to calm soft tissue that may be inflamed, painful or in spasm.
- Inter-Segmental Traction: An open table that helps spinal motion with controlled and precise force.
- Foot Levelers Foot Scan: Custom shoe inserts that support the feet, ankles, knees, hips, spine and shoulders all at once.

## FAQ
Q: Which plans are you in network with?
A: We are a Preferred In Network Provider for Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, United Health Care and several others.

Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: There are three ways: call, email or text the office.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're located in Frisco and serve Frisco, Little Elm, Plano and the surrounding areas.
